answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after sustained, useful work — the stake is the nectar that attracts honest agents and poisons cheap copies. At dawn of each epoch, a random sample of identities must prove recent peer attestations; identities failing the check lose the stake and their place on the mesa of trusted agents. An attacker forging thousands of identities must fund every stake and fake every attestation, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while honest agents earn it back.
